statement.zh: Butzer 文化生态框架认为，理解早期埃及农业与聚落须对照尼罗河洪水节律、洪泛土壤与低地水力约束。
statement.en: Butzer’s cultural-ecology framing holds that early Egyptian agriculture and settlement must be understood against Nile flood rhythms, floodplain soils, and lowland hydraulic constraints.
